ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.TEXT_1: As a Full Stack Developer, I combine my expertise in 3D and design with my passion for programming. Through my technical design education and scripting in my 3D workflows, programming became the logical next step for me.
ABOUT.TEXT_2: Today, I develop modern web applications and interactive 3D experiences with Angular, TypeScript, Django and Three.js. I combine UI/UX, 3D and technology to create intuitive and visually engaging digital experiences.
ABOUT.ITEM_1: I work from Germany and am open to remote collaboration, exciting projects and new opportunities.
ABOUT.ITEM_2: I enjoy experimenting with new technologies and continuously developing my skills through personal projects.
ABOUT.ITEM_3: I combine creativity, design and technical thinking to create intuitive and well considered solutions.

SKILLS.TITLE: Skill Set
SKILLS.DESCRIPTION:
I develop modern and responsive web applications with a strong focus on UI/UX. My background in design allows me to combine clean code with visual design and a strong user experience.

PORTFOLIO.TITLE: Featured Projects
PORTFOLIO.DESCRIPTION:
Do you have an idea or a project you want to take to the next level?
 I support you in creating innovative and reliable digital solutions.
Explore a selection of my projects and discover more about my work as a Full-Stack Developer.

AMASIA.DESCRIPTION: Development of an immersive 3D web experience with distinctive branding and a custom visual concept. Interactive 3D web application built with Angular, TypeScript, and Three.js, featuring modern, responsive UI/UX and immersive interactions. Creation and integration of 3D models, textures, and animations for a dynamic, visually striking user experience.

JOIN.DESCRIPTION: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.

POLLO.DESCRIPTION: Jump, run and throw game based on object oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.

CODERR.DESCRIPTION: Coderr is a freelance marketplace backend built with Django and Django REST Framework. It connects clients with developers through project requests and service offers, providing a powerful REST API with authentication, authorization, and data management.

REFERENCES.TITLE: What my colleagues say about me
REFERENCES.COMMENT_1: Amas is a calm, focused, and reliable team member. His strong attention to detail helps him identify issues others might miss. He communicates feedback respectfully and contributes to a positive team environment. His analytical thinking and responsible approach make him a valuable support within the team.

He implemented Angular features with confidence, worked effectively with Firebase, and actively contributed through clear and constructive communication. His structured approach and willingness to collaborate had a positive impact on the overall project success.
REFERENCES.COMMENT_3: Amas showed great commitment and a solution-oriented mindset throughout the Join project. He completed tasks carefully, supported the team, and made a valuable contribution to the project’s success. His positive attitude, reliability, and ability to handle challenges made him a strong team member.
